name: @slop-ai/bridge-server
description: Hosted bridge server for remote MCP hosts and local SLOP relay agents.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target bun --external '@slop-ai/*' --external '@modelcontextprotocol/*' --external 'zod' && bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target bun --external '@slop-ai/*' --external '@modelcontextprotocol/*' --external 'zod' && bunx tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
